chunks.subject: AP World History
chunks.title: SAQ 3 — No Stimulus (3 points) — Set 1: Muslim empires 1300–1600
chunks.content: AP World History SAQ 3 (No Stimulus), 3 points, one per part. Set 1 prompts: A [1] identify one technological or military factor that contributed to the expansion of Muslim empires; B [1] explain one way Muslim rulers c. 1300–1600 used economic policy (to consolidate/expand power); C [1] explain one reason some Muslim rulers c. 1300–1600 pursued a stated policy. 'Identify' = correct answer; 'Explain' = how/why. Common failure: vague identification without characteristics; explain parts that describe rather than give a how/why mechanism; out-of-period examples.

chunks.subject: AP World History
chunks.title: SAQ 3 Set 1 exemplar — Sample 3A, 3/3
chunks.content: SAQ 3 (Set 1) scored 3/3 (A 1, B 1, C 1). Identified a technological/military factor and explained both the economic-policy use and the reason with causal links. Full-credit model.

chunks.subject: AP World History
chunks.title: SAQ 3 Set 1 exemplar — Sample 3B, 2/3
chunks.content: SAQ 3 (Set 1) scored 2/3 (A 1, B 0, C 1). Identified a factor (A) and explained a reason (C) but did not earn the economic-policy explanation (B). Illustrates missing one Explain part.

chunks.subject: AP World History
chunks.title: SAQ 3 Set 1 exemplar — Sample 3C, 1/3
chunks.content: SAQ 3 (Set 1) scored 1/3 (A 1, B 0, C 0). Identified a factor only. Lost both Explain parts (no causal economic-policy use, no reason). Illustrates a response that names a factor but cannot explain mechanisms.
